name: Fashion Psychopath no Sainan
original_name: ファッションサイコパスの災難
source:
I'm Chinatsu Hayami and I killed my mother three days ago, so I'm looking for a "friend" to help dispose of her body and hide her murder. I've got my eye on Takafumi Kato, a self-proclaimed psychopath who also happens to be my classmate.

Kato-kun usually says things like:

"When it comes to guro, I'm into torture and execution videos."
"Oh yeah, and I guess photos of traffic accidents?"
"Anything less bloody doesn't do it for me."
"The guro that's in your usual manga is not nearly enough (lol)"
"Or more like, you couldn't even call that "guro" (lol)"
"I might be a psychopath..."
"I am curious about what it's like to kill someone..."

...so I'm sure we'll become friends!

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5054]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
我是速水千夏，三天前杀了我的母亲，所以我正在寻找一个“朋友”来帮助处理她的尸体并隐藏她的谋杀案。我注意到了加藤贵文，他是一位自称精神病患者的人，而他恰好也是我的同学。

加藤君通常会说这样的话：

“说到九老，我就喜欢酷刑和处决视频。”
“哦，对了，我猜还有交通事故的照片？”
“任何不那么血腥的事情都不适合我。”
“平常漫画里的九郎还不够（笑）”
“或者更确切地说，你甚至不能称其为‘guro’（笑）”
“我可能是个精神病患者……”
“我很好奇杀人是什么感觉……”

……所以我确信我们会成为朋友！

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5054]NovelGame[/url]]
